task: Improve the root README for a newcomer who wants to filter a stream of newline-delimited JSON logs. Inspect the repository, correct stale claims, and make one useful local path obvious.
facts: This is a private, unpublished Node.js CLI. The local invocation is node bin/tracepick.js.
It filters NDJSON from stdin by exact --level value and writes matching original lines to stdout.
It has no hosted dashboard, benchmark, or published npm install path.
